responsibility: Declares shared profiling support data and helpers centered on CFG/edge profiling. It defines edge_profile_info stored in edge aux fields, exposes the bb_gcov_counts and edge_gcov_counts mappings between GCC CFG objects and gcov counters, declares working-set and node-map helpers, the CFG smoothing entry point, edge-count summation, and the global gcov_summary pointer profile_info. This header is the lightweight public interface shared by profile generation/use code and related profile consumers.
same_name_distinction: This header is the lightweight shared interface for CFG profiling support, defining edge_profile_info, bb/edge gcov count accessors, working-set helpers, smoothing entry points, and the global profile_info summary. Unlike gcc/profile.cc, it does not implement instrumentation, spanning-tree selection, or count reconstruction logic.
